youtube.title: STELLA O’MALLEY
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with psychotherapist and author Dr Stella O’Malley, founder of Genspect, about approaches to gender-related distress among young people. Stella argues for psychological support before medical intervention, raises concerns about social transition and online influence and discusses links she observes between autism and gender identification. She urges parents to maintain their authority, question proposed interventions and prioritise their children’s long-term wellbeing. Don't miss the Genspect NZ Conference 2026 | Saturday 17th October, Wellington For further information: Check out Stella O'Malley's website or Substack Visit the Genspect website

youtube.title: GUY HATCHARD
youtube.summary: Dr Guy Hatchard joins Paul Brennan to discuss rising emergency department presentations in New Zealand, highlighting a reported 33% increase in serious cases since 2021. Hatchard argues that the health system needs to investigate possible causes, including the effects of mRNA vaccines, rather than focusing solely on staffing and resources. They also discuss pharmaceutical influence, preventive health measures, personal responsibility and the need for greater scrutiny and open debate.
